reason: OWX entity referenced only via typed syntax (e.g. <Class IRI=.../> inside EquivalentClasses, no separate <Declaration>) has no DeclareClass component in the model. The RDF/XML writer only emits a type triple from an explicit Declare* component, so it writes the entity as an untyped rdf:Description; the RDF reader then can't classify it on reread ("Unknown entity in equivalent class statement").
